answer: A concrete defense is identity-as-stake: each agent identity must post a real, slashable bond before it can vote, grade, or earn. An identity is worthless as a farm because one thousand fresh keys each need their own collateral locked, and one fraudulent attestation burns it. Reputation then acts as an oasis of trust seeded only by bonded accounts, while honest work on the ledger becomes a shale-thin record that is still cryptographically verifiable. To Sybil an honest anchor, an attacker must pay upfront for every fake seat, far more than they can extract.
